assets.credentials: booking_id for guests, resource_id for staff/robots

assets.pickup: municipal service Tue + Fri 07:00 local; extra pickup can be ordered (~24 h lead time)

assets.restock: external vendor Mon + Thu 10:00 local; extra restock can be ordered (~24 h lead time)

notes.cleaner: human housekeeping; only humans can mark a room clean and release it
notes.robot: floor-cleaning robot; shortens human turnover time, cannot clean bathrooms, cannot certify or release a room, never enters an occupied room; can also carry a floor waste bin to the central container (~20 min) - not used in current operations
notes.technician: in-house technician; external contractors appear in work_orders.csv
notes.on_call_housekeeping: one person on call 15:30-22:00 local; ~45 min until on site; one room at a time; costly, for waiting guests only

operations.setpoint_policy: 18 °C setback when unoccupied; 21 °C default when occupied, guests may adjust 19-24 °C
operations.cooling: none (heating-only heat pump; ventilation provides night flushing in summer)

constraints.water_balance: main_meter ≈ sum(room meters) + common areas + losses
constraints.energy_balance: grid_import + pv + battery_discharge = building_load + battery_charge + grid_export

provenance.brand_context: Inspired by public PLATO/CLARA descriptions; no real property data
